1.title: 尤家凹居住社区中心
1.team: 东南大学建筑学院UAG工作室
1.tags: 材料与建筑 × 生活与代际 × 劳动与维护
1.facts: 保留南京压缩机厂的厂房结构，置入菜场、文体及社区服务；设计说明记载了退休职工的反馈。
1.shicha: 工业生产已经结束，结构、工人记忆和周边居民的日常需要仍在延续。
1.exhibit: 旧网架节点与新增空间剖面，配合原职工和现使用者的时间记录。

2.title: 欧阳路历史街区三处微更新：已完成部分
2.sub: 上海虹口 · 2025设计；2026已完成节点
2.team: 山水秀建筑事务所；欧阳路街道、市政总院及协作团队
2.tags: 材料与建筑 × 生活与代际 × 治理与资金
2.facts: 项目包含口袋公园、野草咖啡厅及长寿家园立面更新。2026年9月供稿明确：养老院内院仍在改造。
2.shicha: 街区形象更新的交付时间，与养老照护、树木生长和居民长期使用并不一致。
2.exhibit: 三个节点的共同街区剖面；仅将已完成立面、公园和咖啡厅计入建成范围。
2.cond: 对读。不得把尚未完成的养老院内院或整个片区写成已经完成。
links: 山水秀供稿：欧阳路三处微更新

3.title: 退休房／退休宅
3.sub: 北京海淀 · 2025已有建成报道；文内年代标注不一
3.team: 七巧天工设计：王冰洁、郑昊鸿
3.tags: 生活与代际 × 材料与建筑 × 劳动与维护
3.facts: 两位老人居住的旧三居经调整，闲置卧室转为日常活动空间，并设置书画、收纳和适老动线。
3.shicha: 家庭人口与身体能力持续变化，住宅的原始房间分配却长期固定；子女与父母的改善愿望也可能不同。
3.exhibit: 两代人的平面标注与一天活动记录，展示改造协商中的具体选择。
3.cond: 核心。优先取得老人自己的评价。来源标题区写2024，项目表写2025年2月，故不强行给出单一竣工日。
links: 七巧天工项目资料：退休房

4.title: 彭一小区原拆原建：已交付住宅
4.sub: 上海静安 · 2021开工；2025年6月启动回搬
4.team: 静安区、彭浦新村街道、上海市房屋建筑设计院及建设团队
4.tags: 生活与代际 × 治理与资金 × 材料与建筑 × 劳动与维护
4.facts: 老住宅拆建后交付回搬；政府报道记录了多轮户型调整以及长期居住于此的老年居民。
4.shicha: 数年的过渡居住，占据老年人有限生命的一部分；原址返回也不自动恢复原有邻里关系。
4.exhibit: 匿名家庭生命线与拆建、过渡、回搬时间对齐；并列不同户型迭代。
4.cond: 核心对照。需说明拆除必要性、过渡生活和实际回搬体验；不将报道时尚未完成的配套综合体计为建成。
links: 上海市政府：彭一小区回搬

5.title: 福田中学改扩建
5.tags: 生活与代际 × 材料与建筑 × 治理与资金
5.facts: 原址更新的校园通过密集复合的空间安排容纳增加的教育需求，并设计了与社区衔接的设施。
5.shicha: 每届学生仅在校数年，校园建设与城市人口变化却跨越更长周期；教学和社区活动具有不同时间表。
5.exhibit: 一周设施时刻表与校园剖面叠合，展示开放与管理界面。

6.title: 西安老菜场市井文化街区一期

6.shicha: 每日经营依赖稳定的路径与租用条件，新消费和改造投入则按另一套周期组织。
6.exhibit: 摊位日历、分期剖面和租用变化的并置。
6.cond: 核心。保留市场外观不足以证明原商户持续受益，需核实商户更替、费用与经营时段。

7.exhibit: 早市、收市与清洁三个时段的空间记录及商户时间线。

8.title: 新华社区营造中心
8.team: 新华路街道＋大鱼营造及社区参与者
8.tags: 生活与代际 × 治理与资金 × 劳动与维护
8.facts: 已开放的社区营造场所为居民活动和共同参与提供固定空间。
8.shicha: 一次空间交付容易被看见，持续组织活动、协调意见与维护关系则依赖反复投入的劳动。
8.exhibit: 居民发起事项与空间变动共同构成的日历；展现参与者的实际决策。

9.title: 巷子里街区·社区公共空间更新
9.team: 一介建筑 Nhoow＋玉林东路社区
9.tags: 生活与代际 × 劳动与维护 × 治理与资金 × 材料与建筑

9.shicha: 需求通过使用才逐渐显现，一次性任务书难以预先容纳后续参与者和活动。
9.exhibit: 三期平面与反馈事件叠合，每次调整标明提出者、时机和后续影响。

10.title: 劲松北社区改造一期示范区
10.sub: 北京朝阳 · 2019年8月完成示范改造
10.team: 劲松街道、愿景集团及居民／物业合作方

12.title: 先锋会泽白雾书局
12.sub: 云南曲靖会泽 · 2024设计；2025年4月完成施工
12.team: 家琨建筑＋先锋书店；会泽铜都文旅
12.tags: 材料与建筑 × 生活与代际 × 劳动与维护
12.facts: 废弃粮仓的危旧屋架被替换，旧夯土墙保留为围护，新结构承担荷载；墙面亦有新的艺术处理。
12.shicha: 墙体、屋架和原用途具有不同的终止时间，物质留存与历史意义变化并不同步。
12.exhibit: 旧墙—新结构的实体节点及粮仓功能、地方记忆和经营的时间剖面。
12.cond: 对读。保留原物不等于保持原貌；需讨论墙面涂饰、材料老化和居民可及性。

13.title: 小河公园

16.shicha: 建筑物质可以延续，投资方案却可能中断、更替；空间在不同开发周期中等待。

17.title: 西三旗砖窑里创新场

17.facts: 旧工业空间经过分期设计与施工形成新的使用场所，旧砖窑遗存参与空间组织。
17.shicha: 窑炉和厂房的物质寿命，超过其原生产周期；改用又带来新的维修和经营节奏。
17.exhibit: 窑体节点、维修边界与空间用途变更的时间剖面。
17.cond: 对读。须证明旧物延用的具体范围，并呈现实际使用而非仅保留的形式。

18.title: 星火761北京数字经济算力中心

18.tags: 材料与建筑 × 计算与反馈 × 劳动与维护 × 生态与地域
18.facts: 旧电子工业空间被更新为包含数字经济和算力相关功能的复合场所。
18.shicha: 厂房可能服务数十年，机电和计算设备更替更快，城市数字服务又要求连续运行。

20.title: 鱼尾洲公园
20.tags: 生态与地域 × 材料与建筑 × 劳动与维护
20.facts: 在鱼塘和受工业活动影响的场地上，通过水陆空间组织形成适应水位变化的公园。
20.shicha: 开园是一个事件，水位、植被演替和场地恢复则有周期与不确定性。
20.exhibit: 同一断面在不同水位下的变化，并与多年植被记录连接。
20.cond: 对读。生态效果需连续记录支持，不将设计目标直接写成恢复结果。

21.title: 美舍河凤翔湿地公园
21.team: 土人设计及河道治理、建设运营团队
21.tags: 生态与地域 × 治理与资金 × 劳动与维护
21.facts: 河道治理与湿地公园建设共同改变场地，形成城市公共空间。
21.shicha: 短期工程推进必须接续长期水质改善、污水管理和湿地维护。

21.cond: 对读。水质改善不能全部归因于景观设计；需明确截污等工程的作用。
links: 土人设计：美舍河凤翔湿地

22.title: 顺德云鹭湿地博物馆

22.tags: 生态与地域 × 生活与代际 × 材料与建筑

22.cond: 对读。应核实照明、游客量与栖息变化；不能以“看得见鸟”证明没有干扰。

24.title: 大布村文化生活空间

25.title: 安茶博物馆工场

25.team: 普罗建筑 office PROJECT：李汶翰、常可
25.tags: 劳动与维护 × 生态与地域 × 生活与代际 × 材料与建筑

25.exhibit: 一段制作工序与建造调整并置，明确哪些是日常生产、哪些是演示。
25.cond: 对读，证据要求较高。项目名称包含“工场”，不能据此断言持续生产已经形成。
links: 谷德对设计师访谈：安茶博物馆工场

26.title: 丰梧季·乡村记忆博物馆
26.tags: 生活与代际 × 材料与建筑 × 治理与资金
26.facts: 在旧宅已经消失的场地上新建小型记忆博物馆，以地方日常物件组织叙事。
26.shicha: 建筑可以重新建起，生活记忆却分散在不同人的一生中，且不断变化。
26.exhibit: 物件传承与场地变化两条线，由村民补充讲述。
26.cond: 对读。应标明新建性质，不能称为原宅保留；检验谁有权决定被展示的记忆。
links: IARA供稿：丰梧季记忆博物馆

27.title: 青山艺术村文化礼堂
27.team: MOMENTUM建筑设计事务所：黄明健
27.tags: 生活与代际 × 材料与建筑 × 劳动与维护
27.facts: 原礼堂拆除后重建，新的场所承担村庄集体活动。
27.shicha: 物质替换与集体生活延续并不等价；新建筑应接续反复发生的礼仪与活动。
27.exhibit: 一年的集体活动与旧新礼堂空间对照。
27.cond: 对读。明确拆除重建事实，并解释为何不能采用修缮或局部更换。

28.title: 洱海生态廊道阳南溪—才村示范段
28.sub: 云南大理 · 2020开放的约12公里示范段
28.team: 大理地方政府、苍洱投资及多专业设计建设团队
28.tags: 生态与地域 × 生活与代际 × 治理与资金 × 劳动与维护
28.facts: 限定选择已经开放的示范段，将湖岸生态治理与公共慢行空间联系起来。
28.shicha: 岸线改造的项目周期，与湖泊恢复及周边居民生活变化所需的时间不同。
28.exhibit: 同一湖岸的水位、通行和生活变化剖面。
28.cond: 对读。不要将全线规模、迁居人数或绩效套到这一示范段；需呈现居民实际经历。
links: 人民网云南：示范段开放报道

29.title: 红梅文创园工业建筑更新
29.sub: 辽宁沈阳 · 2020建成项目记录
29.team: AA architects青木宏＋IIA Atelier佐藤芳子等
29.tags: 材料与建筑 × 劳动与维护 × 生活与代际
29.facts: 原味精厂建筑经过保留和改用，生产空间成为新的文化活动载体。
29.shicha: 工业工序、工人职业生涯与新经营活动处于不同时间结构。
29.exhibit: 原生产顺序与现通行路径叠合，加入工人生命史。
29.cond: 对读。需要劳动史与使用记录，否则容易退化为一般工业风文创园展示。
links: 设计团队项目资料（有方稿件转载）

30.title: 福田红树林生态公园及持续运营
30.sub: 广东深圳 · 2015开放；后续持续运营
30.team: 福田区政府建设；红树林基金会MCF运营
30.tags: 生态与地域 × 劳动与维护 × 治理与资金 × 生活与代际
30.facts: 公园由社会组织参与运营，生态管理和自然教育构成持续性的场所实践。
30.shicha: 鸟类迁徙与生境变化跨越年度预算，志愿服务和专业管理具有不同的持续条件。
30.exhibit: 年度预算、维护劳动与迁徙季的时间剖面，呈现具体调整。
30.cond: 核心。优先以多年记录支撑判断，区分公园范围与相邻保护区，避免混用生态成果。
links: 红树林基金会：福田生态公园
世界湿地网络：福田红树林生态公园自然教育中心

31.title: 数字藏经洞
31.sub: 甘肃敦煌／线上 · 2023年4月18日上线
31.tags: 生活与代际 × 计算与反馈 × 劳动与维护
31.facts: 以数字扫描、游戏引擎和互动叙事呈现藏经洞及相关历史。
31.shicha: 历史研究长期累积，观众以短时交互进入；软件与设备的可用年限也可能短于保存目标。
31.exhibit: 一个可体验的历史场景及其证据—建模—更新剖面。
31.cond: 对读。属于互动数字项目，不直接称为头显VR；须与2025中国馆《敦煌共熠》的具体素材区分。

32.title: 圆明园四十景数字化复原及应用
32.sub: 北京／数字场景 · 2025成果发布与应用
32.team: 圆明园管理处＋中央美术学院相关研究中心
32.tags: 生活与代际 × 计算与反馈 × 材料与建筑
32.facts: 团队以历史图像、建筑研究和数字建模形成四十景复原成果，并发展展示应用。
32.shicha: 遗址保留失落的历史，实时图像却容易呈现一个看似完整、确定的过去。
32.exhibit: 同一地点的遗址、史料和数字复原；模型中的推测部分可切换显示。
32.cond: 对读。限定央美此项成果，不混称清华等团队更早的圆明园研究；不把数字复原当作实物重建依据。
links: 中央美院：数字复原成果亮相双城展
人民网北京：四十景成果发布

33.title: 云冈第12窟可移动3D打印复制窟
33.sub: 山西大同／浙江杭州 · 2016采集；2019制作完成；2020展出
33.team: 云冈石窟研究院＋浙江大学
33.tags: 材料与建筑 × 计算与反馈 × 劳动与维护 × 生活与代际
33.facts: 通过扫描与3D打印制成可移动的等比例洞窟复制品。
33.shicha: 不可移动遗产的长期保存，与公众跨地域访问、扫描时刻和复制材料寿命相交。
33.exhibit: 获授权的局部复制构件与采集—制造—巡展时间剖面。
33.cond: 对读。不能把实体复制称为VR，也不能未经尺寸核算就承诺运输整窟。
links: 人民周刊：云冈12窟复制项目

34.title: 鼓浪屿黄荣远堂数字测绘与修复协作
34.sub: 福建厦门 · 2025公开报道的实践
34.team: 厦门大学文化遗产学社／李渊＋遗产管理与修复团队
34.tags: 计算与反馈 × 材料与建筑 × 劳动与维护 × 生活与代际
34.facts: 学生和修复团队将激光扫描、无人机航测和BIM用于黄荣远堂记录及修复研究。
34.shicha: 扫描冻结某一时刻，建筑劣化持续发生；数据也需要后来者维护和理解。
34.exhibit: 同一构件的现场状态、扫描与修复决策，标明记录日期及版本。
34.cond: 核心。应呈现模型如何影响具体修复，不以“永久数字保存”代替长期维护机制。
links: 厦门大学：黄荣远堂数字化修复实践

35.title: 曹斐《永不消逝的电波》The Eternal Wave
35.sub: 北京工业空间记忆／VR作品 · 2020作品
35.team: 曹斐＋Acute Art；VIVE Arts合作呈现
35.tags: 生活与代际 × 计算与反馈 × 材料与建筑
35.facts: VR作品以北京红霞影剧院及电子工业区的经验为基础，发展关于现实与虚构的空间叙事。
35.shicha: 工业空间可能改变或消失，个体记忆与虚构仍能形成另一种进入过去的方式。
35.exhibit: 原作品VR体验与其场地关系的简明时间剖面。
35.cond: 核心。保留艺术作品的独立叙事，不把虚构解释成历史证据；设备与展示权需另行落实。

36.title: 腾讯贵安七星数据中心一期
36.sub: 贵州贵安 · 2018一期试运行；2021有运营说明
36.team: 腾讯及设计建设、运维合作方
36.tags: 生态与地域 × 计算与反馈 × 材料与建筑 × 劳动与维护
36.facts: 工程开挖的山体洞库用于数据设施，运营方说明了利用当地条件组织冷却的做法。
36.shicha: 长寿命山体工程容纳更快更替的计算设备，并支持城市连续在线的服务。
36.exhibit: 城市—网络—洞库的剖面，叠合设备更换与建筑维护。
36.cond: 对读。不是直接占用天然洞穴；节能不能只引用企业宣传，需运行边界与数据。
links: 腾讯云：贵安七星一期介绍
腾讯：数据中心能源实践

37.title: 海南陵水海底数据中心一期
37.sub: 海南陵水海域 · 2023年11月完成一期建设
37.team: 海兰信／海兰云及建设运营合作方
37.tags: 计算与反馈 × 生态与地域 × 材料与建筑 × 劳动与维护
37.facts: 一期海底数据舱建设完成，海水冷却成为数据设施的空间条件。
37.shicha: 芯片升级、舱体检修、海洋环境变化与海底工程寿命并不同步。
37.exhibit: 海岸—海底舱体剖面与设备升级、维护窗口的对齐。
37.cond: 对读。限定一期，不采用计划百舱的预测节能值；生态与全寿命表现仍需实际资料。
links: 中国科学院网信工作网：一期完成

38.title: 腾讯天津数据中心余热回收供暖
38.team: 腾讯及热泵／供暖协作团队
38.tags: 计算与反馈 × 生态与地域 × 生活与代际 × 劳动与维护
38.facts: 通过热泵回收数据中心余热用于供暖，连接计算与建筑环境系统。
38.shicha: 计算持续产热，供暖需求却随季节变化；两者负荷不必然匹配。
38.exhibit: 一年供热需求与余热供给的双曲线及管网剖面。
38.cond: 对读。运营方披露支持项目存在，不能独立证明全年净节能；需实际负荷与受益范围。
links: 腾讯：天津数据中心余热供暖实践

39.title: 龙羊峡水光互补光伏项目一期
39.sub: 青海海南藏族自治州 · 2013年12月并网试运行
39.team: 黄河上游水电开发公司及工程协作团队
39.tags: 生态与地域 × 计算与反馈 × 治理与资金 × 材料与建筑
39.facts: 一期光伏工程接入既有水电系统，以水光互补组织电力输出。
39.shicha: 日照波动、水库调节、河流季节与城市用电需求在不同尺度上相互影响。
39.exhibit: 一天与一年两个时间窗口的水光—负荷关系及流域剖面。
39.cond: 对读。限定一期，不混用后续扩建容量；供电稳定性不能直接代表全部生态绩效。
links: 国家能源局：龙羊峡一期并网

40.title: 数字孪生都江堰：渠首与灌区调度
40.sub: 四川成都平原 · 2022—2025持续建设；2026有运行报道
40.team: 四川省都江堰水利发展中心及技术／基层水利团队
40.tags: 计算与反馈 × 生态与地域 × 劳动与维护 × 生活与代际
40.facts: 渠首建模、监测和远程闸门控制进入持续运行；报道记录了调度时间的变化。
40.shicha: 快速计算与调度依赖长期水工知识、田间季节、维护劳动和不断变化的来水条件。
40.exhibit: 一次实际配水事件，同时展示水情、预测、操作与后续田间反馈。
40.cond: 核心。限定已运行系统，区分报道中的局部效率与整个灌区效果；不将数字孪生一概称为AI。
links: 科技日报：都江堰数字孪生运行报道

A01.prop: A thirty-year section from shell completion to partial opening, long vacancy, regulatory reassessment, retrofit, and present use. Pair retained concrete volume with the slower institutional creation of women’s and children’s services.
A01.gate: Verify current occupancy, public access, energy performance, and user experience independently of the architect’s report. It has already hosted MVRDV’s *ReviveR* exhibition, so avoid reproducing that exhibition’s self-narration.
A01.tracks: Material and Building; Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial; Project and Maintenance
A01.body:
Adaptive reuse, care infrastructure  
 MVRDV with local partners; 2019–2023  
 Material and Building; Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial; Project and Maintenance

A02.title: Nantou Ancient City regeneration / 南头古城更新
A02.prop: Do not exhibit a completed masterplan. Build a versioned map of six interventions, resident/business turnover, event periods, rent and access shifts, and what remained outside the project boundary.
A02.gate: High familiarity and prior biennale exposure. It earns a place only through current afterlife evidence, resident accounts, and a critical account of commercialization.
A02.tracks: Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial; Project and Maintenance; Material and Building
A02.body:
Historic city, urban village, gradual regeneration  
 URBANUS and multiple public/private actors; 2016 onward  
 Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial; Project and Maintenance; Material and Building

A03.prop: One brick biography across clay extraction, firing, kiln use, dismantling, incorporation into the museum, weathering, and future repair. Add oral knowledge from kiln workers.
A03.gate: The project has already circulated internationally, including MoMA’s *Reuse, Renew, Recycle*. Verify China Pavilion history and use fresh operational/craft evidence rather than the familiar image of brick vaults.
A03.tracks: Material and Building; Lived and Cultural; Project and Maintenance
A03.body:
Material reuse, craft and cultural infrastructure  
 Studio Zhu Pei; completed 2020  
 Material and Building; Lived and Cultural; Project and Maintenance

A04.title: *Forest*, Yan Wang Preston / 严望佳《森林》
A04.prop: Revisit a small sample of photographed trees in 2026–27. Pair original images with current survival, maintenance, source-village, and land-value records. The commission turns an existing artwork into a new longitudinal test.
A04.gate: Tree locations, present access, image rights, and the ethics of tracing source communities.
A04.tracks: Ecological and Territorial; Governance and Financial; Lived and Cultural; Material and Building
A04.body:
Longitudinal photography and film  
 2010–2017  
 Ecological and Territorial; Governance and Financial; Lived and Cultural; Material and Building

Preston followed mature trees transplanted into Chongqing and new-town landscapes for eight years. The work exposes the mismatch between an instant visual promise of “forest city” and the biological time, rural extraction, mortality, property value, and

A05.title: Handshake 302 and the Baishizhou archive / 握手302与白石洲档案
A05.prop: A room-scale “lease clock” using one apartment’s changing occupancy, rent, redevelopment milestones, weekly salons, departures, and returns. Let the archive show what official project time leaves out.
A05.gate: Current organizational status, residents’ consent, redevelopment-stage verification, and protection against turning displacement into atmosphere.
A05.tracks: Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial; Project and Maintenance; Material and Building
A05.body:
Participatory art, urban research, inhabited archive  
 2013 onward  
 Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial; Project and Maintenance; Material and Building

Handshake 302 began in a 12.5-square-metre apartment in Baishizhou and built a long record of site-specific residencies, public events, and discussion around the urban village. It offers something most renewal cases lack: cultural work

A06.title: *Biotopy*, Wendi Yan / 闫文笛《Biotopy》
A06.prop: Run a Venice culture and a China culture under shared display rules, with growth curves, sensor updates, care logs, and game-state changes shown together. The pavilion becomes a six-month experiment rather than a static demonstration.
A06.gate: Biological import, lab safety, daily care, backup protocol, authorship of scientific contributions, and what happens when organisms or sensors fail.
A06.tracks: Ecological and Territorial; Sensing and Computational; Project and Maintenance

Live bio-digital installation and game  
 2024 onward  
 Ecological and Territorial; Sensing and Computational; Project and Maintenance

A07.prop: Pair the film with the dossier’s 贵安七星 data-centre section. One side shows verified infrastructure and maintenance cycles; the other shows what secrecy, inaccessibility, and dependence feel like from the city.
A07.gate: Screening rights and a disciplined separation of fiction, artist research, and operational fact.
A07.tracks: Sensing and Computational; Ecological and Territorial; Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial
A07.body:
Film and research on digital infrastructure  
 2023  
 Sensing and Computational; Ecological and Territorial; Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial

Set around Guiyang’s largely inaccessible data-centre landscape, the film connects cloud infrastructure, climate, urban transformation, and human memory through a speculative journey after a data-centre crash. It supplies the lived and imaginar

A08.title: Chen Qiulin’s Three Gorges sequence / 陈秋林三峡影像序列
A08.prop: Align the three works with river level, demolition, relocation, and the artist’s returns. Use the sequence as a counter-section to official infrastructure time.
A08.gate: Rights, exact work selection, sensitivity around displacement, and a clear reason for revisiting older works in a call that prioritizes recent practice. A new 2026–27 return commission would solve the temporal problem.
A08.tracks: Lived and Cultural; Ecological and Territorial; Governance and Financial; Material and Building

Video, photography, installation  
 *Farewell Poem* (2002–07), *River, River* (2005), *The Garden* (2007)  
 Lived and Cultural; Ecological and Territorial; Governance and Financial; Material and Building

Across successive stages of demolition, inundation, migration, and new construction, Chen’s works refuse the single project date. They make redevelopment legible through memory, artificial flowe

A09.title: Infrastructure of the Ordinary: The Shanzhai Trolley / 日常基础设施：山寨手推车
A09.prop: A working trolley prototype carries components between pavilion sections on a daily route. Its movement log becomes a live time section of the exhibition’s own maintenance.
A09.gate: It was already shown at the 2025 UABB Huaqiangbei sub-venue. Verify eligibility, develop a genuinely new Venice iteration, and make workers collaborators rather than visual evidence.
A09.tracks: Project and Maintenance; Lived and Cultural; Sensing and Computational; Governance and Financial

Design research, fieldwork, prototype  
 Nicolás Penna and Yanyu Sun; shown 2025–26  
 Project and Maintenance; Lived and Cultural; Sensing and Computational; Governance and Financial

B01.title: Shanghai Expo Village afterlife audit / 上海世博村赛后使用复访
B01.tracks: Material and Building; Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial; Project and Maintenance
B01.body:
Designed for Expo 2010 staff and later conversion to ordinary urban uses, the district is a clear test of event time versus neighborhood time. The existing evidence is still designer-led. Invite a 2026–27 post-occupancy commission on conversion, vacancy, tenure, repair, and daily use.

B05.title: *The Earth Is an Image*, Xin Liu / 刘昕《地表之下 别无他物》
B05.tracks: Sensing and Computational; Material and Building; Lived and Cultural
B05.body:
An antenna receives signals from retired satellites that still pass over Hong Kong and transmit data decades after obsolescence. It is a precise case of technical afterlife and recurring orbital time. This was already in the earlier art longlist in broader form, so treat it as a specification, not a wholly new lead.

 Sensing and Computational; Material and Building; Lived and Cultural  
 [M+ proj

B06.title: *Waiting for a Friend (without Appointment)*, Pak Sheung Chuen / 白双全《等一个没有约的朋友》
B06.tracks: Lived and Cultural; Sensing and Computational
B06.body:
Waiting in public space becomes both method and material. The work gives the pavilion a human-scale counterpoint to planning schedules and predictive systems. It is geographically and institutionally sensitive for a national pavilion, older than the call’s preferred range, and best used as a methodological reference or a new commission rather than a core loan.

 Lived and Cultural; Sensing and Com

R01.title: Microbial Self-Healing Concrete / 微生物自修复混凝土
R01.body:
Materials research  
 徐晶 Jing Xu, School of Materials Science and Engineering (Civil Engineering Materials), Tongji University; patents from 2019, papers to 2025  
 Material and Building; Sensing and Computational; Project and Maintenance

Microbially induced calcium-carbonate precipitation seals cracks: crack → bacterial activation → mineralization → closure. Xu's group holds a patent for a microbial self-healing method for already-built reinforced-concrete structures and in 2025 published an electromigration-based self-healing strategy for existing concrete; parallel work studies healing under seawater salinity.
R01.tracks: Material and Building; Sensing and Computational; Project and Maintenance
R01.prop: A material clock shown directly: cracked specimens at Day 0 / 7 / 28 / 90 of healing beside the building-scale cycle they interrupt (crack → inspection → repair contract → budget year). Live specimens can keep healing across the six months of the pavilion.
R01.gate: A research programme, not a built work: confirm with Xu that specimens can travel and be exhibited, and whether any field application on an existing structure exists. Quote healing rates only from the papers, and never present laboratory closure rates as building performance.
links: Tongji faculty page (research directions, patents, papers)

R02.title: Futian Mangrove Ecological Park — Long-term Monitoring and Citizen Science / 福田红树林长期生态监测与公民科学
R02.body:
Ecological operation and monitoring  
 深圳市红树林湿地保护基金会 Mangrove Conservation Foundation (MCF); park run by MCF since 2015, China's first municipal park operated by a non-profit  
 Ecological and Territorial; Project and Maintenance; Lived and Cultural; Sensing and Computational

A 38-hectare urban park on Shenzhen Bay run under a government–professional–public model. Recorded bird species rose from 83 to 220 and vascular plants from 307 to 754 (MCF, to Nov 2023). MCF's 2024 annual report (verified): the year's park bird survey recorded 136 species in 14 orders and 43 families; 171 birds ringed; 20 nest boxes with 7 magpie-robin pairs fledging 25 young; a citizen bird-strike survey of 432 buildings by 454 participants found 39 strikes, and the park's retrofitted zone recorded zero; a biodiversity-friendly streetlight was patented; visits and education programmes reached about 2 million people.
R02.tracks: Ecological and Territorial; Project and Maintenance; Lived and Cultural; Sensing and Computational
R02.prop: A live time section: the park's clocks — visitor hours, daily monitoring rounds, migration and breeding seasons, the annual management plan, decade-scale habitat change — plotted against one another, with monitoring data continuing to arrive during the exhibition. The ecological monitor as the city's slowest, most patient sensor.
R02.gate: Confirm MCF's willingness to share monitoring data during the exhibition and the data-use terms; agree how volunteers and citizen scientists are credited. Keep the Ecological Park (MCF-run) distinct from the adjacent National Nature Reserve in every label and figure.
links: MCF — Futian Mangrove Ecological Park page

R03.title: Smart Yingxian Wooden Pagoda — Digital Twin and Preventive Conservation / 智慧应县木塔：数字孪生与文物保护
R03.body:
Heritage survey, digital twin, monitoring  
 刘畅 Chang Liu, Institute of Architectural History and Heritage Conservation, School of Architecture, Tsinghua University, with Lenovo; launched Feb 2023, immersive app Apr 2024, sensing upgrade 2025–26  
 Sensing and Computational; Material and Building; Lived and Cultural; Project and Maintenance

The timber pagoda of 1056 (佛宫寺释迦塔), surveyed by Tsinghua over decades, now has a layer-by-layer digital twin (15 million+ mesh faces; NeRF + XR). The 2025 upgrade added multimodal sensing — a legged robot with 3D vision scanning without contact — and AI detection of timber deformation and paint loss as quantified evidence for preventive conservation and early warning.
R03.tracks: Sensing and Computational; Material and Building; Lived and Cultural; Project and Maintenance
R03.prop: Three clocks on one wall: a structure of 1056, a lean measured in decades, scans captured in seconds. Show one bracket set (斗栱) as 1930s survey drawing, 2020s point cloud and current deformation alert — and ask who keeps the model when the scanning team leaves.
R03.gate: Confirm with Liu Chang which materials are Tsinghua's to lend (survey drawings, point clouds) and which belong to Lenovo or the heritage authority; do not restage the commercial VR app. Verify the 2025–26 monitoring claims against Tsinghua sources, not press.
links: 澎湃 2024-04-27: 智慧应县木塔 launch

A10.title: Beijing Silvermine / 北京银矿 — Thomas Sauvin
A10.body:
Archive, found photography  
 Thomas Sauvin 苏文 (French collector and artist), Beijing / Paris; since 2009  
 Lived and Cultural; Material and Building; Governance and Financial

Since 2009 Sauvin has salvaged discarded colour negatives from a recycling plant on the edge of Beijing, where they were bound for destruction and silver recovery. The archive now holds over 850,000 anonymous photographs (the homepage says 'over a million') spanning 1985 to 2005, the first two decades of popular colour photography in the capital, and has become one of the largest archival projects in China.
A10.tracks: Lived and Cultural; Material and Building; Governance and Financial
A10.prop: A sorting table: the negatives shown as material (silver, acetate, the recycler's price per kilo) and as memory (the same frames as family time), with the years 1985–2005 laid against the districts and buildings that have since gone.
A10.gate: Consent and anonymity: the photographs are anonymous by nature; agree with Sauvin which series can be shown in a national pavilion and how subjects are protected. The silver-recovery detail is to be confirmed with him; the site names the plant and the salvage, not the process.

R04.title: China's Unfinished Buildings as Urban Stranded Assets / 中国烂尾建筑的城市搁浅资产研究
R04.body:
Research (industrial ecology, urban studies)  
 段华波 Huabo Duan, School of Environmental Science and Engineering, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, with 白雪梅 Xuemei Bai (ANU) and co-authors; One Earth 9(5), 101649, published 19 March 2026 (CC BY)  
 Governance and Financial; Material and Building; Ecological and Territorial

A georeferenced inventory of 1,779 unfinished residential projects in 142 Chinese cities as of the end of 2023 (the highlights say 1,799). It quantifies the materials locked in (485 Mt of steel, cement, brick and tile, sand and stone, per the graphical abstract) and 181 Mt of emissions, a 9.6% rise in the real-estate sector's carbon intensity, about 2.6 million disability-adjusted life years of PM2.5 health burden, and 347 ± 32 billion USD of economic losses borne unevenly by buyers, builders and local governments, with the projects clustering in new suburbs.
R04.tracks: Governance and Financial; Material and Building; Ecological and Territorial
R04.prop: The inventory map beside one building's ledger: purchase date, stalled date, years waiting, material stock by the tonne, carbon and money locked in. The unfinished building as the pool's clearest case of finance stopping while matter and people keep aging.
R04.gate: Research, not a site: the inventory is georeferenced and buyers are identifiable, so use aggregate figures unless the authors clear project-level detail. Cite the published version; reconcile the two counts (1,779 / 1,799) with the authors before either appears on a wall.

A11.title: Former Kunming Rubber Factory Renovation / 昆明橡胶厂改造 — Kokaistudios
A11.body:
Adaptive reuse, industrial heritage  
 Kokaistudios (Shanghai); client Realtop Real Estate Group; commissioned 2011, completed 2017; 30,000 m² on a one-hectare site, Xishan District, Kunming  
 Material and Building; Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial; Project and Maintenance

A factory founded in 1956, at its peak in the 1980s with 2,000 workers, defunct around 2000. The studio read the site as layers of material time: black bricks of the 1950s–60s, red bricks of the 1970s–80s, cement facades of the 1990s. It kept five buildings and the smokestack, demolished one low-value warehouse to make a public space, added curved glass volumes on columns, and opened the walled compound to mixed uses (lofts, retail, a brewery, offices).
A11.tracks: Material and Building; Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial; Project and Maintenance
A11.prop: One wall, three bricks: samples of the 1950s black brick, the 1970s red brick and the 1990s cement render with their dates, beside the 2011–2017 project line and the site's employment curve (0 → 2,000 → 0 → present tenants).
A11.gate: Developer-led (Realtop): verify occupancy and public access in 2026, nine years after completion, before it stands for reuse that lasted. Ask the studio for post-occupancy material, not only the 2017 photographs.

A12.title: Xiwusutu Village Centre / 西乌素图村民中心 — 张鹏举
A12.body:
Community building, reclaimed material  
 张鹏举 Zhang Pengju, 内蒙古工业大学建筑学院; Hohhot, Inner Mongolia; Aga Khan Award for Architecture 2025 (16th cycle), Sanlian 建筑贡献奖 2025  
 Material and Building; Lived and Cultural; Project and Maintenance

A single-storey centre built on the site of the village temple, using old bricks reclaimed from village demolition and laid by village craftsmen, around two old trees kept at the centre of a 回-shaped plan; exhibition hall, kitchen and courtyard are joined. The architect describes summer evenings of chess and children and winters of crowded painting exhibitions.
A12.tracks: Material and Building; Lived and Cultural; Project and Maintenance
A12.prop: The brick's second life: where each reclaimed brick came from in the village and when it was first laid; the temple site's memory before the building; a year of use in two seasons, with the villagers who built it as its keepers.
A12.gate: Confirm with the architect the brick provenance record and the villagers' consent to appear; use the studio's own photographs rather than award publicity.
links: Southeast University news on the Aga Khan Award

A13.title: Guanzhong After-Harvest Art Festival / 关中忙罢艺术节 — 武小川
A13.body:
Rural art programme, annual event  
 武小川 Wu Xiaochuan, 西安美术学院; 关中艺术合作社 (founded 2018); Caijiapo village, 鄠邑区, Xi'an; every year since 2018 in the lull after the wheat harvest (忙罢); Sanlian 社区营造奖 2025  
 Lived and Cultural; Project and Maintenance; Governance and Financial; Ecological and Territorial

Since 2018 an art cooperative led by Wu Xiaochuan has held the festival in the wheat fields of Caijiapo after each harvest: symphony, 秦腔 and theatre in the fields, a refurbished village museum, an 艺术村长 residency that brings urban youth to live in the village. By 2022 the village collective's income had risen from 21.6 to about 80 million yuan and over 200 villagers worked in tourism (Xinhua, 2022).
A13.tracks: Lived and Cultural; Project and Maintenance; Governance and Financial; Ecological and Territorial
A13.prop: A calendar as the exhibit: the farming year, the festival's week, the residency's months and the village's income year on one wheel, for seven editions; who leaves after the festival and who stays.
A13.gate: Confirm current figures and the 2023–25 editions with the cooperative; income data must be sourced to the village or the cooperative, not press. Villagers appear only with consent.

A14.title: Nanshan Hundred Schools Renewal / 深圳南山百校焕新行动 — 周红玫、朱竞翔
A14.body:
District-scale campus renewal programme, cluster design mechanism  
 周红玫 Zhou Hongmei (overall planner, 南山区建筑工务署) and 朱竞翔 Zhu Jingxiang (academic planner, CUHK); launched March 2022, three years; Sanlian 城市创新奖 2025  
 Project and Maintenance; Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial

143 existing schools and kindergartens (70 schools, 73 kindergartens) renovated over three years, about 1.5 million m², for about 125,000 pupils, through a 'personalised design + unified construction' mechanism that brought dozens of design offices into one programme.
A14.tracks: Project and Maintenance; Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial
A14.prop: Three summers: the programme drawn as the work windows it actually had, each school's eight weeks against a pupil's six years and the district's three-year plan; the mechanism shown as a calendar, not an organogram.
A14.gate: Verify the holiday-window scheduling with Zhu Jingxiang; the sources describe the mechanism, not the timing. 南山区建筑工务署 is government: decide whether to invite the planner, the bureau or both.

A15.title: Taoxichuan (Universe Porcelain Factory, Ceramic Machinery Factory) / 景德镇陶溪川文创街区（宇宙瓷厂、陶机厂） — 张杰; paired with 川上行 (直向建筑)
A15.body:
Industrial heritage district, maker economy  
 张杰 Zhang Jie (Tsinghua School of Architecture; 北京华清安地, 清华同衡 heritage centre); design 2012–13, phase 1 opened Oct 2016, phase 2 Aug 2022; Sanlian 公共空间奖 2025. Pairing: 川上行（景仰书院）by 直向建筑 Vector Architects, courtyards planned around a stand of old trees inside the zone  
 Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial; Material and Building; Project and Maintenance

宇宙瓷厂 was built in 1956 with Soviet aid; its tunnel kiln was converted from coal to oil (1970s) and gas (1980s). The 2011 brief, in the architect's words, was fourteen broken factories and fifty thousand laid-off workers to be converted within a year. By Oct 2023 some 22,000 景漂 makers had settled, with rent-free stalls and unified management.
A15.tracks: Lived and Cultural; Governance and Financial; Material and Building; Project and Maintenance
A15.prop: Four clocks on one street: the kiln's three fuels, the year the workforce was laid off, the fourteen-year project, and the maker stalls that turn over every season. 川上行's trees as the one clock that predates them all.
A15.gate: Second Jingdezhen card beside A03 御窑博物馆; keep the two distinct (imperial kiln brick / state-factory afterlife). Maker turnover and rent-free terms must come from the operator, not press.

A16.title: Liangma River Waterfront Corridor / 北京亮马河滨水景观廊道 — AECOM
A16.body:
River corridor, urban ecology  
 AECOM (design lead above the Fourth Ring, integrating landscape, hydraulics, aquatic ecology, bridges and lighting); client 朝阳区水务建设管理中心; from 2019; 5.575 km core section; 18 km slow-traffic system opened June 2023; Sanlian 生态友好奖 2025  
 Ecological and Territorial; Governance and Financial; Lived and Cultural; Project and Maintenance

A channelised river of the 1980s–90s, hemmed in by building backs, reopened as a continuous waterfront in four years, with night boat routes and terraces; the Beijing Water Authority documents the commercial and ecological programme together.
A16.tracks: Ecological and Territorial; Governance and Financial; Lived and Cultural; Project and Maintenance
A16.prop: Water quality, aquatic life and bird counts on their own timelines beneath the nightly clock of boats and terraces; the 1980s channel section beside the 2023 one.
A16.gate: Monitoring data must come from the water authority, not marketing; AECOM is the invitable party, the district is government (Helena's call).
